name: Herbert Marcuse
shortBio: German-American philosopher, political theorist, and leading member of the Frankfurt School whose critique of advanced capitalism and technocracy became the intellectual catalyst of the New Left.
centralQuestion: "How can authentic human liberation be achieved when advanced industrial society pacifies dissent through consumerism and false needs?"

keyWorks.title: Reason and Revolution: Hegel and the Rise of Social Theory
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking defense of Hegelian negative dialectics as critical thinking that resists positivist and authoritarian social theories.

keyWorks.title: Eros and Civilization: A Philosophical Inquiry into Freud
keyWorks.description: Synthesizes Marx and Freud, arguing modern technological productivity renders surplus repression obsolete, opening the possibility of non-repressive civilization.

keyWorks.title: One-Dimensional Man: Studies in the Ideology of Advanced Industrial Society
keyWorks.description: Seminal diagnosis of consumer capitalism and technocratic rationality creating a totalitarian consensus through repressive desublimation.
